configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.displayName: Native (SDL2 + GLES2/Software, OpenAL audio) -- the WASM twin
configurePresets.description: 32-bit native build (needs libsdl2-dev:i386, libopenal-dev:i386). Mirrors the web renderer set + real OpenAL audio (2.12.0 sensible default). Builds in build-native/.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O2 + DWARF + assertions. The everyday dev build — named stacks and readable errors while the engine still runs at a playable speed. Builds in build-wasm/. Run `source ~/emsdk/emsdk_env.sh` first (sets EMSDK).

configurePresets.name: wasm-debug
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O0, nothing inlined, every local live. Reach for it when the OPTIMISER is the suspect — a bug that shows at one -O level and not another is almost always undefined behaviour. Builds in build-wasm-debug/.

configurePresets.name: wasm-perf
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build (-O3, no debug/assertions -> smaller/faster). Builds in build-wasm-perf/.

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: 32-bit Windows build. Cross-compiles from Linux via the toolchain file (i686-w64-mingw32 + a fetched SDL2); the SAME preset works from an MSYS2 MINGW32 prompt, where pacman's SDL2 answers instead. BUILD_STATIC links every package into the exe — no Core.dll/Engine.dll, and appGetDllHandle resolves through the internal registry, not LoadLibrary. Renderers are SoftDrv + NullDrv (CPU-only, so it verifies headless under wine+Xvfb); hardware GL is out of scope. Builds in build-windows/. [ufront 2.33]
